plan.title: Rank-based auction vendor and buyer views

steps.note: Open the single-stage creation flow where auction strategy is configurable.
Enable eRFX event creation required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation as required.
Set the event to a rank-based reverse auction awarded as one lot.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the first available reverse-auction pricing template.
Add the requested product with quantity 10.
Set the first row's delivery location.
Confirm the requested delivery location was selected.
Complete the remaining pricing-sheet fields.
Invite three QA vendors for Vendors A, B, and C without inventing company names.
Commit the 30-minute schedule starting now.
Publish the configured auction.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Submit Vendor A's bid at 100.
Confirm the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's lower bid at 95.
Confirm the second vendor bid was accepted.
Inspect the available invited QA vendor's supplier-portal view.
Open the auction pricing round in the vendor portal.
Verify the inspected vendor sees its live rank.
Verify the inspected vendor does not see the competing bid price.

args.need: open the second vendor's own supplier-portal session and verify that vendor sees Rank 2 without seeing the other vendor's price

steps.note: The catalog cannot create or switch to a second vendor's independent portal session.
Return to the buyer console for the live response check.
Open the buyer's Responses view for the published auction.
Confirm both bids are visible to the buyer and two of three invited vendors responded.
Confirm the buyer can see the first bid price.
Confirm the buyer can see the second bid price.
Confirm the buyer's live response view shows Rank 1.
Confirm the buyer's live response view shows Rank 2.
